baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated verbs كَذَّبَ and عَصَىٰ join an active truth verdict to departure from obedience.
baseline_models.mechanism: كَذَّبَ assigns falsity to what or who confronts the subject; عَصَىٰ then locates that verdict inside an authority relation by enacting departure from obedience. The pair therefore couples epistemic classification and practical revolt rather than listing unrelated faults.

activation_trace.role: Active attribution of falsity supplies the epistemic verdict.
Departure from obedience supplies the relational and enacted breach.

changed_reading.before: He denied something and separately committed disobedience.
changed_reading.after: He branded the presented claim or bearer false and, in the same response, withdrew from the obedience relation; judgment and revolt operate together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The truth-opposition range of ك ذ ب is immediately coordinated with the overt act عَصَىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because the falsity branch can concern both saying and doing, the second verb can function as the behavioral body of the first. Disobedience does not merely follow denial; it makes the denial legible in conduct.

activation_trace.role: Truth's opposite across speech and action allows denial to exceed a spoken claim.
The overt exit from obedience gives the preceding denial a behavioral form.

changed_reading.before: كَذَّبَ is verbal denial, while عَصَىٰ adds a second offense.
changed_reading.after: The second verb externalizes the first: disobedience is denial performed, exposing opposition to truth in deed as well as verdict.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A non-persistence branch of ك ذ ب is held beside عَصَىٰ's departure from an obedient course.
baseline_models.mechanism: The image of an animal running a stretch and then stopping to look behind supplies a kinesthetic possibility: apparent forward movement breaks and reverses orientation. Beside عَصَىٰ, the pair can sketch discontinuation of a required course, though the ordinary denial reading remains primary at baseline.

activation_trace.role: A run that stops and looks back supplies the material image of failed continuation.
Leaving obedience converts interrupted motion into a social and purposive departure.

changed_reading.before: The two verbs are static moral predicates.
changed_reading.after: The pair may also carry a broken-trajectory image: repudiation interrupts and turns away from a course that should have continued.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening supplies contested pulling, consequence-aware management, and command. Against that ordered motion, the focus pair reads as a local countermotion: denial contests the warrant of the command, while disobedience pulls the agent out of its governed course.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsity supplies the justificatory contest against the ordered address.
Leaving obedience supplies the human counter-course.
Mutual pulling between sides contributes a force model for resistance rather than mere passivity.
Managing an affair by looking to its consequence supplies the ordered trajectory being resisted.
Command as demand and obligation gives عَصَىٰ a concrete authority pole.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 stacks coordinated movement clauses and culminates in the management of أَمْرًا.
79:21 likewise compresses its response through initial فـ and coordination with و.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forceful contest, management toward consequences, and command; I infer that the opening order frames the later refusal as countermotion. A live alternative is that the opening agents describe eschatological operations without directly supplying a normative frame for Pharaoh.

changed_reading.before: The pair records one individual's denial and rule-breaking.
changed_reading.after: The pair is a human counter-order lodged inside a surah of directed motion: a truth verdict is used to pull free of an already managed command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in constructs a route from exceeded limits through purification and gentle guidance toward reverent fear, then makes a sign visible. The focus pair reverses both lanes of that route: كَذَّبَ reclassifies the shown sign as false, and عَصَىٰ refuses the offered reorientation of life and allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsity turns the visible sign into a rejected truth claim.
Departure from obedience blocks the relational destination of guidance.
Exceeding the boundary in disobedience states the condition the offered route is meant to repair.
Purification and rectification supply the first offered change that the focus response refuses.
Gentle direction toward the true path supplies the route from which disobedience exits.
Fear joined with awe supplies the intended affective endpoint of guidance.
Causing something to be seen supplies the evidentiary disclosure immediately preceding denial.
A manifest sign supplies the object actively assigned to falsehood.

structural_cues: 79:17-20 forms a conditional and purposive chain: transgression, invitation, purification, guidance, fear, and shown sign.
The فـ of فَكَذَّبَ makes the pair the immediate response to فَأَرَىٰهُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an offered transformation and an immediately shown sign; I infer that the two focus verbs deliberately invert its evidentiary and obedient dimensions. The live alternative is that the verbs simply report aftermath without mirroring each step of the offer.

changed_reading.before: He responded negatively after receiving evidence.
changed_reading.after: He reverses a carefully offered route: he falsifies what was made visible and exits the obedience toward which purification, guidance, and awe were directing him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah places turning one's back beside purposeful motion. That sequence sharply activates the baseline non-persistence image of ك ذ ب: the subject moves, but his movement is back-turned and cannot count as continuation along the offered route.

activation_trace.role: A run that halts to look behind supplies the dormant interrupted-course image.
Departure from obedience identifies which course has been abandoned.
Turning the back and withdrawing realizes the backward orientation latent in the focus branch.
Purposeful motion shows that refusal generates energetic movement, but in the wrong direction.

structural_cues: 79:22 follows the focus pair immediately with ثُمَّ and combines أَدْبَرَ with يَسْعَىٰ.
The narrative therefore juxtaposes repudiation, departure, backward orientation, and active motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a run-stop-look-back branch and then explicit back-turning plus striving; I infer retroactive activation of a broken-trajectory image in كَذَّبَ. The dominant alternative remains ordinary denial, with 79:22 describing only its consequence.

changed_reading.before: The broken-course image was a remote focus-only possibility.
changed_reading.after: The next movement clause makes it concrete: denial and disobedience initiate a vigorous but back-turned course whose momentum is already a failure to continue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering, raising a public call, asserting what is not, and claiming lordship turn the focus pair into a struggle over public truth and jurisdiction. The one who assigns falsity to the sign answers by producing a rival attribution for himself; disobedience becomes attempted transfer of obedience to self-authorized rule.

activation_trace.role: Assigning falsity supplies the accusatory move later reversed by the speaker's own claim.
Leaving obedience supplies the jurisdictional break that rival lordship attempts to institutionalize.
Driving and gathering a group toward a purpose scales the refusal from private response to collective action.
A raised public call gives the counterclaim an audience and broadcast mechanism.
Saying or attributing what was not supplies the false counter-assertion made after accusing the sign of falsity.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty identify the authority relation the counterclaim tries to seize.

structural_cues: 79:23-24 runs through فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ فَقَالَ, making the response progressively public.
The uncited branchless descriptor ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ intensifies the rival claim without serving as a branch trigger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, proclamation, an attribution of what is not, and sovereignty; I infer that the subsequent sequence unpacks denial as counter-publicity and disobedience as jurisdictional secession. A live alternative is that these acts are consequences of the focus pair rather than part of its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: He privately rejected the sign and disobeyed its implied command.
changed_reading.after: He converts rejection into a public rival truth regime: accusing the sign of falsehood, gathering an audience, and relocating obedience under his own asserted lordship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast supplies a governance chain: exceeding limits and preferring the lower life stand opposite fearing and restraining the self from desire. Read through that chain, denial is the truth-claim that protects a preferred valuation, while disobedience is the enacted result of an inner self left unrestrained.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsity supplies cognition's defense of the preferred order of value.
Departure from obedience is the outward action generated by failed self-governance.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience generalizes Pharaoh's condition into the negative eschatological type.
Preference by choice supplies the valuation decision upstream of conduct.
Life construed as benefit and good supplies the apparent value that captures preference.
The lower or worldly horizon narrows the preferred value to what is near and lesser.
Restraint and checking supply the missing control operation implied by disobedience.
The inward locus of reason and apprehension supplies the governable interior agent.
Inclination of the self supplies the directional pressure that restraint must oppose.

structural_cues: 79:37-41 balances طَغَىٰ and preference against fear and self-restraint, then assigns opposed refuges.
The repeated ط غ ي links Pharaoh's narrative condition in 79:17 to the generalized human type in 79:37.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference, lower-life value, self, restraint, and desire; I infer a loop in which denial rationalizes the preferred value and disobedience enacts it. The reverse direction remains live: prior denial could instead reshape value and release desire.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a mistaken belief and disobedience is its separate behavioral sequel.
changed_reading.after: The pair compresses a governance loop: lower-life preference empowers desire, failed restraint appears as disobedience, and denial supplies the truth verdict that protects the arrangement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing permits a question about timing while locating the event's anchorage and endpoint with the Lord. This distinguishes not knowing from actively assigning falsity: كَذَّبَ is culpable epistemic overreach, not the mere absence of inaccessible timing knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsity supplies a positive adverse judgment, stronger than suspended knowledge.
Questioning and requesting knowledge supply the alternative posture of acknowledged uncertainty.
Anchoring and settled stability give the unknown event a real terminus rather than making it false.
Lordship and sovereignty identify where authority over the event's knowledge resides.
The endpoint reached by a thing marks a determinate limit whose timing is reserved, not negated.

structural_cues: 79:42 asks when the Hour will be anchored; 79:44 places its endpoint with the Lord.
The closing answer limits human timing knowledge without withdrawing the warning in 79:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a question, real anchorage, sovereign ownership, and an endpoint; I infer a contrast between warranted uncertainty and active falsification. A live alternative is that the question itself is derisive, so the contrast describes available postures rather than the questioners' actual innocence.

changed_reading.before: Denial may be treated as simple failure to know or believe.
changed_reading.after: Denial is an unauthorized certainty that the disclosed truth is false, sharply distinct from admitting that its divinely held timing is unknown.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the obligation or incitement branch belongs to a different كذب construction, not the focus ayah's ordinary form-II syntax. It remains packet-anchored through the same focus root, explicit عَصَىٰ, and the opening command branch. Downstream prose should present it only as an ironic lexical counter-echo, never as a translation of كَذَّبَ here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The obligation-tinged branch of ك ذ ب is inverted by the focus pair's explicit attribution of falsity and departure from obedience.

activation_trace.role: The idiom of taking something up as incumbent supplies the obligation pole that the focus use reverses.
Departure from obedience makes the reversal of obligation explicit.
Demand and obligation provide the whole-surah command field against which the reversal becomes audible.

changed_reading.before: The root only contributes rejection of truth.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, the root also carries the shadow of incumbency precisely where the subject declares false and exits obedience: obligation is turned inside out.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because fabrication of false speech is a branch-distant possibility of خ ل ق, not the contextual parse of خَلْقًا in 79:27. It remains valid as an activation because كَذَّبَ is anchored in active falsity-attribution while the same packet root inventory juxtaposes actual making with fabricated speech and the following clauses supply joined, straightened construction. Render it as a cross-domain echo of counter-making, not as lexical disambiguation of خَلْقًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَذَّبَ anchors an attempted false redescription of the sign, activated by the later contrast between true making and fabricated speech.

activation_trace.role: Active falsity-attribution supplies the focus act that seeks to redescribe what has been shown.
Actual origination and making supply the truthful construction against which denial operates.
Fabricating false speech supplies the distant counter-making image activated beside كَذَّبَ.
Building by joining parts supplies a coherent made order resistant to false redescription.
Straightness and completed integrity sharpen the contrast between formed reality and fabricated account.

changed_reading.before: Denial merely refuses the displayed sign.
changed_reading.after: In a contained cross-domain reading, denial attempts a counter-creation: fabricating an account capable of redescribing a manifest, coherently made order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the no-tarry branch of ك ذ ب is idiomatic and form-distant from كَذَّبَ. It remains anchored through the exact focus branch and the surah's single rebuke plus closing compression of tarrying. Downstream prose should qualify it as a temporal undertone: denial cannot purchase delay, not as an alternate dictionary rendering of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The no-delay branch of ك ذ ب gives the act of denial a temporal edge without replacing its ordinary falsity sense.

activation_trace.role: Doing without lingering supplies the latent no-delay image attached to the focus root.
A forceful vocal rebuke supplies the event that collapses attempted postponement.
Singleness concentrates the transition into one non-extended act.
Tarrying and slowness supply the closing duration that retrospective perception radically compresses.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a negative truth verdict.
changed_reading.after: Denial also casts a futile temporal bid: the truth it rejects is not delayed by rejection, and experienced duration collapses when that truth arrives.

strongest_changes: The 79:17-20 offer turns the pair into a precise reversal of purification, guidance, awe, and shown evidence.
The immediate أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ sequence sharply activates the otherwise remote run-stop-look-back branch of ك ذ ب.
The gathering and lordship proclamation scale denial into a public rival truth and authority regime.
The 79:37-41 contrast recasts the pair as a cognition-action loop driven by preference and unrestrained desire.
The closing question and divinely held endpoint distinguish denial from legitimate uncertainty about timing.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context did not settle one gloss; it changed the terse pair along several mechanisms at once. Most distinctive was the immediate motion activation in 79:22, while the wider surah supplied ordered-command, transformative, political, appetitive, epistemic, creative, and temporal frames that all remain anchored in one or both focus roots.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the run-stop branch can color the form-II focus verb beyond an associative material echo.
Whether the opening movers directly frame Pharaoh's refusal as counter-order or remain a separate eschatological tableau.
Whether lower-life preference generates denial, denial licenses preference, or the two reinforce each other bidirectionally.
The obligation, counter-creation, and no-delay outliers must remain echoes rather than replacement translations.
